evidence: aerobic end at 97% of the yearly best while the short end sits at 58% — top-end capacity is the gap, not aerobic fitness

durability_trend.source: activity decoupling, sessions of 45min or more

progression.method: Trend is 42d against 90d. Level is 42d as a percent of the 1y best. The windows are nested, so the 1y comparison is a level reading only and is never scored as gain or decline.

repeatability.note: 'untested' means no session reached the anaerobic depth threshold — it says nothing about capacity, only that capacity was not probed.
repeatability.source: activity max W' balance depletion as a percent of W'

frame.after: Easy 45 minutes at low endurance, then cool down
frame.spacing: Separate maximal tests by at least one day, with an easy recovery day before the sprint test. Test efforts need not fall on the same day.
frame.warmup: Warm up thoroughly before any maximal effort

tests.protocol: 2 x 10s maximal sprint, flying start, full recovery between. Day 5 of the baseline week — always after a recovery day, never on accumulated fatigue.
tests.reason: sitting at 58% of the yearly best — either the capacity dropped or it has not been probed lately, and the data cannot tell which

tests.protocol: 5-minute maximal test. Day 1 of the baseline week — it opens the week because it is the least fatiguing of the long efforts and anchors VO2max.
tests.reason: sitting at 84% of the yearly best — either the capacity dropped or it has not been probed lately, and the data cannot tell which

power_profile.note: Scores are ordinal positions between the table's anchor rows, not true percentiles. Phenotype comes from the shape of the profile, never from one duration alone.
power_profile.phenotype_reason: 5s, 1min sits below the table floor, which is under 'average untrained'. For a training athlete that means the effort was never made in this window, not that the capacity is absent. Phenotype cannot be read from an untested duration.
power_profile.test_duration_basis: all-rounder default — phenotype is unknown until the profile is tested, and the day-2 duration depends on it. Run the testing week at the default, then the phenotype resolves and later tests use its duration.

projection.caveat: Unplanned days are projected as zero load. With few planned sessions on the calendar this understates future CTL.
projection.method: Banister exponential, CTL tau 42d, ATL tau 7d

durability.source: activity decoupling, sessions of 45min or more
